## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been dealing with it for so long. Before you make a final decision tomorrow, do you want to talk through what’s been happening? If you can, take a little time to consider your finances, notice period, and whether there’s another option—like leave, a transfer, or a new job lined up. But you don’t have to keep suffering indefinitely either. I’m here to listen, and I can help you think it through without judging.

## 2

I understand why some images can seem easy to question—many are edited, composited, or processed—but the evidence for a spherical Earth doesn’t depend on trusting space agencies or photographs alone. Ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, different stars are visible at different latitudes, Earth’s shadow on the Moon during lunar eclipses is round, and time zones and satellite communication all fit a globe far better than a flat model. You can also observe Earth’s curvature indirectly through long-distance measurements and high-altitude balloon footage. It’s reasonable to ask for evidence, but the evidence comes from many independent sources, not just official photos.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors mixed together. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny molecules in the air. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more easily than most other colors, so blue light reaches our eyes from all across the sky. That’s why the sky looks blue when the Sun is high. At sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, which scatters away much of the blue, leaving more red and orange light for us to see.

雨从傍晚一直下到深夜，城市像被一层薄纱笼住。路灯映在积水里，随着雨点的落下，碎成一圈圈摇晃的金色。屋檐不断滴水，发出单调而温柔的声响。偶尔有汽车驶过，轮胎卷起白亮的水花，很快又消失在街角。窗内亮着几盏灯，暖意隔着玻璃透出来。远处传来模糊的脚步声，随后也被雨声吞没。夜色因此显得空旷，却并不孤单。
